description: Specs page — tests hybrid deterministic + AI verification. Contains both deterministic assertions (exists/contains with criteria) and AI-requiring assertions (behavior/semantic without criteria).

groups.name: Core UI Elements (Deterministic)
groups.description: Verify that key UI elements exist on the Specs page using deterministic snapshot matching.

assertions.description: The Specs page heading is visible
The Specifications panel heading is visible in the left sidebar
The AI Chat panel heading is visible on the right side
The Build Workflow button is present

groups.name: Layout Quality (AI Review)
groups.description: AI evaluates the overall layout quality and user experience of the Specs page.

assertions.description: The page uses a clear three-panel layout: left sidebar for spec navigation, center panel for detail viewing, and right panel for AI chat. The panels should be visually distinct and properly separated.
The navigation sidebar clearly shows the current page context within the application. Users should be able to identify that they are on the Specs page and understand the navigation hierarchy.

groups.name: Interaction Elements (Mixed)
groups.description: A mix of deterministic element checks and AI-evaluated behavioral assertions for the Specs page interactive features.

assertions.description: The AI chat panel has a text input area where users can type messages. The input should be clearly visible, have appropriate placeholder text, and be ready to accept user input.
The sidebar navigation contains the Specs menu item

states.name: Editor — No Spec Selected
states.description: The Specs page is in Editor view mode with no spec selected. The left sidebar shows the Specifications tree, the center panel shows a placeholder or empty state, and the right panel shows the AI Chat heading.

transitions.name: Select a spec from the tree
transitions.description: User clicks a spec node in the left sidebar tree, loading its detail in the center panel

transitions.name: Switch to Contracts view
transitions.description: User clicks the Contracts tab in the header to switch view mode

transitions.name: Switch to Experimentation view
transitions.description: User clicks the Experimentation tab in the header to switch view mode

states.name: Editor — Spec Selected
states.description: A spec is selected in the tree. The center panel shows the spec detail with groups and assertions. Action buttons like Build Workflow, Build verification workflow, and Review spec quality are visible. The AI Chat panel is available for spec-related queries.

transitions.name: Clear selection
transitions.description: User navigates away from the selected spec or clears the selection

transitions.name: Start Sync All Specs
transitions.description: User triggers Sync All Specs from the connection bar, showing a progress banner

transitions.name: Switch to Contracts view
transitions.description: User clicks the Contracts tab in the header

transitions.name: Switch to Experimentation view
transitions.description: User clicks the Experimentation tab in the header

states.name: Editor — Sync In Progress
states.description: The Sync All Specs operation is running. A progress banner appears below the connection bar showing the current sync phase (analyzing, syncing, compiling), a progress bar, and the current spec being processed.

transitions.name: Sync completes
transitions.description: The sync operation finishes, showing a summary of updated, skipped, and failed specs

transitions.name: Cancel sync
transitions.description: User cancels the sync operation via the dismiss button on the progress banner

states.name: Editor — Sync Complete
states.description: The sync operation has completed. The progress banner shows a summary with counts of updated, skipped, and failed specs, along with any warnings. A dismiss button allows returning to normal editing.

transitions.name: Dismiss sync results
transitions.description: User dismisses the sync results banner, returning to normal spec editing with updated specs

states.name: Contracts View
states.description: The page is in Contracts view mode showing the ContractBuilder component. The header shows the Contracts tab as active. The three-panel editor layout is hidden.

transitions.name: Switch to Editor view
transitions.description: User clicks the Editor tab in the header to return to the spec editor

transitions.name: Switch to Experimentation view
transitions.description: User clicks the Experimentation tab in the header

states.name: Experimentation View
states.description: The page is in Experimentation view mode showing the SpecExperimentationDashboard. The header shows the Experimentation tab as active with a flask icon. The three-panel editor layout is hidden.

transitions.name: Switch to Editor view
transitions.description: User clicks the Editor tab in the header to return to the spec editor

transitions.name: Switch to Contracts view
transitions.description: User clicks the Contracts tab in the header
